My earlier answer was wrong to date the start to 1986. The tenant entered lawfully under the 1985 lease, which ran until 1992, and deciding to stay and withholding rent did not by itself repudiate the owner's title, so the possession was not yet hostile. The period began only once the holdover became hostile, which on these facts was no earlier than the lease's expiration in 1992 and possibly later, once the tenant's repudiation was communicated to the owner. Twenty years from any date after 1989 would not have run before the Boy Scouts' 2009 discovery, so the tenant's claim fails unless hostility began on or before 1989, which the facts don't show.

CONFIDENCE: 45
